raregear.name: The Observer's Lens (Accessory):
raregear.effect:
A flawless crystal lens set in an iron chassis. Looking through it, one can see the faint, shimmering outline of a creature's vital weaknesses.

Once per scene you may designate one enemy as **observed**. The first time you hit your **observed** enemy with an attack, the attack deals 10 extra damage.

special.name: Lethal Observation
special.effect:
When an enemy that Bishop can see **performs the Spell or Skill action**, that enemy becomes **observed** and any previously **observed** enemies stop being **observed**.

During their first turn of each round other than the first, Bishop performs their **basic attack** targeting **only** their currently **observed** enemy. If this attack hits the **observed** enemy, it deals 10 extra damage and that enemy also suffers **shaken**.

special.name: Calculated Aim
special.effect: Bishop enters each conflict with an empty six-section Clock named **"Execution Protocol"**. Whenever an enemy becomes **observed**, fill 1 section of this Clock.

special.name: Sight Acquired
special.effect: At the start of Bishop's turn, if their **Execution Protocol** Clock is full, erase all of its sections. Then, if any sections were erased this way, Bishop **must** use their first available action during that turn to perform the **Spell** action and cast **Execution Protocol**. If Bishop is unable to cast **Execution Protocol** for any reason, Bishop loses all actions for that turn instead.

actions.name: Mark for Death
actions.effect: Bishop may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to **mark** an enemy that they can see. The next source of damage dealt to an enemy with **mark** deals an additional 5 damage, or 10 damage if the target is in **crisis**.

spells.name: Execution Protocol
spells.effect: Bishop unleashes a calculated barrage of arrows, dealing 10 **physical** damage to every enemy they can see. This damage increases to 30 **physical** damage for any enemies currently **observed**.

notes.name: Tactics
notes.effect:
**Mark for Death** (on "observed" target) > **Pinning Shot** (on "observed" target) > **Mark for Death** > Repeat

**Forced Action (First Turn):** **Pinning Shot** must be made against the current **observed** target.

**Forced Action:** When the **Execution Protocol** clock is full, Bishop must use its first action to cast **Execution Protocol**.
